$comment: 🔮 Test-only third-party references of the print product. Every entry is a devDependency of 📦️packages/🟦️typescript and is imported only from 🧪️tests/**; no runtime code may depend on one. `@oracle-<id>` tags in the Gherkin features name these ids.

oracles.reason: Judges 🖼️assets/🔣️viz-catalog.json against 🧬️schema/🔣️.json with a real JSON Schema draft 2020-12 implementation instead of erased TypeScript types.
Judges the binning, tick, quantile and ordering transforms of semio-viz-transform against the implementation they are ported from, so a rounding rule cannot agree with itself.
Judges the band and linear scales the families place their cells and marks with, instead of restating the same arithmetic in the test.
Judges the pie angle assignment, including the sort order, pad angle and partial-circle handling that the arc families depend on.
Reads the taxonomy leaf set out of a CommonMark token stream, so the product's own line-oriented parser cannot agree with itself.
